content.raw:
Nephrology is the branch of internal medicine concerned with kidney health and disease, including blood pressure, fluid and electrolyte balance, and the effects of other illnesses and medicines on the kidneys. At our partner hospital, nephrologists provide outpatient, inpatient and intensive care services, all forms of dialysis and assessment for kidney transplantation with lifelong follow-up. MedLuxLife coordinates your appointments and treatment schedule and organises the practical details of your stay.

Treatments and services

Outpatient clinic

Diagnosis and treatment of kidney diseases, preventive care for people at higher risk such as those with diabetes or hypertension, and supportive care for advanced kidney disease.

Inpatient care and consultations

Ward-based care and follow-up, plus nephrology consultations for other departments.

Kidney effects of other conditions and medicines

Evaluation of how diabetes, hypertension, rheumatological disease, acute illness or long-term medicines such as chemotherapy, anti-rheumatic drugs and cortisone may affect the kidneys.

Intensive care kidney support

Haemodialysis, haemofiltration, haemodiafiltration and continuous venovenous haemofiltration for patients with acute kidney failure.

Haemoperfusion and plasmapheresis

Blood purification treatments that may be used when clinically indicated.

Haemodialysis

Acute or chronic haemodialysis, with session frequency and length adjusted to remaining kidney function and diet.

Peritoneal dialysis

Peritoneal dialysis including continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (CAPD), which patients perform themselves at home.

Kidney transplantation

Assessment for transplantation in end-stage kidney disease, with transplantation through the organ transplant unit and lifelong post-transplant follow-up.

Conditions treated

  • Structural and functional disorders of the urinary system
  • Hereditary kidney diseases
  • Polycystic kidney disease
  • Familial Mediterranean fever
  • Amyloidosis
  • Kidney stone disease
  • Fluid, electrolyte and acid-base disorders
  • Hypertension and hypertensive kidney disease
  • Kidney and urinary tract infections
  • Diabetes-related kidney disease
  • Kidney involvement in rheumatological diseases
  • Kidney problems related to fluid loss, heart failure or sepsis
  • Medication-related kidney damage
  • Acute kidney failure
  • End-stage kidney disease

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Recent kidney function and urine test results
  • Dialysis prescription and session records, if on dialysis

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Nephrology consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
